remarks: Desirable walk-to-town River Ridge community. Spectacular views, and so many great features! Craftsman's millwork/coffered ceilings, hardwood floors, open floorplan and move-in ready condition. Main level Primary Suite, home office, specialty flooring in garage and finished walk out lower level. Exceptional in every way, this pristine home offers a truly enviable lifestyle just minutes from town. Enjoy an unbeatable location with Schenk's Island and Bradley Park only a two-minute walk away, the SoNo train station just 15 minutes by car, and access to the Norwalk River Valley Trail only three minutes from your doorstep. A rare opportunity to enjoy beauty, convenience, and outdoor recreation in one remarkable setting-schedule your visit today. Interior furnishings are different than furnishings in photos.
